steps.title: :參數
:取得綁定裝置資訊
steps.details:
1.根據 udId 查詢綁定裝置資訊
SELECT CustId,Udid,DeviceName FROM  DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBinding WHERE (UUID = @UUID) and QuickLoginType <> 'P'
資料庫： DAWHOSql
目標表： DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBinding
用途：取得待解綁裝置的完整資訊（排除純推播 'P' 類型）
查詢結果會轉換為 BindDevice 物件，再轉為 BindDeviceLog 物件，設定：
BindingType = "UNBINDING"
ACTIONTYPE = "BINDING_DEL"
ACTIONMPHONENAME = 操作者的手機名稱

steps.title: :寫入綁定解除 Log
steps.details:
寫入解綁日誌 — InsertBindingLog
INSERT INTO DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBindingLog
(BindingType, PushToken, UserID, UUID, IPAddress, QuickLoginDate, DeviceName,
QuickLoginType, OSVersion, AppVersion, DeviceActive, GeneralPushActive,
DevicePushActive, CreateUser, CreateDate, ModifyUser, ModifyDate,
QuickLoginTermVersion, TermsVersion, ACTIONMPHONENAME, ACTIONTYPE, SMSMOBILE)
VALUES
(@BindingType, @PushToken, @UserID, @UUID, @IPAddress, @QuickLoginDate, @DeviceName,
@QuickLoginType, @OSVersion, @AppVersion, @DeviceActive, @GeneralPushActive,
@DevicePushActive, @CreateUser, @CreateDate, @ModifyUser, @ModifyDate,
@QuickLoginTermVersion, @TermsVersion, @ACTIONMPHONENAME, @ACTIONTYPE, @SMSMOBILE)
資料庫： DAWHOSql
目標表： DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBindingLog

steps.title: :執行實際「刪除裝置綁定」
steps.details:
1、查詢裝置資訊
SELECT  CustId,Udid,DeviceName  FROM DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBinding
WHERE UserID = @UserID AND UUID = @UUID AND QuickLoginType <> 'P'
檢查是否存在指定 UserID 和 UUID 的設備，且該設備的 QuickLoginType 不是 'P'（代表該設備不是被標記為已解綁的設備）查詢結果若有資料，則發送推播通知
string parameters = string.Format("[PARAM0]={0}^|$[PARAM1]={1}",
dsResult.Tables[0].Rows[0]["DeviceName"].ToString(), date);
CommonFunc.SendToMonitorMail_Push("Type0_DA_UNBINDING_DEVICE.html", ...);
2、檢查是否有推播類型紀錄
SELECT CustId,Udid,DeviceName  FROM DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBinding
WHERE UserID = @UserID AND QuickLoginType = 'P'
若存在則清除舊推播紀錄
DELETE FROM DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBinding WHERE (UUID=@UUID OR USERID=@USERID) AND QuickLoginType = 'P'
DELETE FROM dbo.MB_PUSHTYPESETTING WHERE UserId = @UserId
3、核心解綁（UPDATE，非物理刪除）
UPDATE DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBinding
SET QuickLoginType = 'P', MIDTYPE = NULL, MIDTYPEID = NULL, FIDOFLAG = NULL,
FIDOTIMESTAMP = NULL, MIDREQSEQ = NULL, FIDOQRID = NULL, QKLOGTIMESTAMP = NULL
WHERE UUID = @uuid AND UserID = @CustID
重點：解綁不是 DELETE，而是把 QuickLoginType 降級為 'P'（僅保留推播功能），並清空所有 MID/FIDO 相關欄位。
4、清理殘留紀錄
DELETE FROM DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBinding
WHERE (UserID = @UserID OR UUID = @UUID)
AND QuickLoginType = 'P' AND PushToken IS NULL
如果設備已成功標記為解綁，則再刪除該設備在資料庫中的資料
---------------------------
如果所有操作成功，則回傳 true，表示設備已成功解除綁定。如果過程中出現任何錯誤，則會記錄錯誤並回傳 false。
